items.title: AI-ready biological data: $1.8B global commitment
items.summary: Biohub, DOE, NIH, Google, Isomorphic Labs, and Meta commit $1.8 billion to expand the Virtual Biology Initiative's open, AI-ready biological data.
items.titleZh: 面向 AI 的生物数据：全球承诺投入 18 亿美元
items.summaryZh: Biohub、美国能源部（DOE）、美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）、Google、Isomorphic Labs 和 Meta 承诺投入 18 亿美元，扩展虚拟生物学计划的开放式、面向 AI 的生物数据。

items.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
items.summary: An open speech recognition model that runs on the same CPU engine as Needle. It transcribes seven languages, reaches the first token in 11 ms, and loads beside Needle so one binary turns a clip straight into tool calls.
items.titleZh: Whistle：仅 16.9 MB 的语音转文字模型
items.summaryZh: 这是一款开放式语音识别模型，与 Needle 使用同一 CPU 引擎。它可转录七种语言，首个 token 延迟为 11 毫秒，并能与 Needle 一同加载，让一个二进制文件即可将音频片段直接转化为工具调用。

items.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
items.summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.
items.titleZh: 遭解雇的 OpenAI 安全研究员否认不当行为指控，警告此举将产生寒蝉效应
items.summaryZh: 三名遭解雇的 OpenAI 安全研究员否认不当处理敏感信息的指控，并在公开信中警告，他们被解雇一事正在对公司的 AI 安全文化产生寒蝉效应。

items.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
